chunks: Al-Bazanti narrated from Dawud ibn Sirhan, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:

That the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله participated with Quraysh in the building of the House. So the share belonging to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was from the door of the Ka'bah to the midpoint of what lies between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone.

key_terms.الرُّكْنِ الْيَمَانِيِّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Ka'bah
key_terms.سَاهَمَ: participated jointly or took a share in the work

ai.seo_question: What part of the Ka'bah was assigned to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله during its rebuilding with Quraysh?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله took part with Quraysh in rebuilding the Ka'bah. It identifies the specific section associated with him, preserving a historical detail connected to the sacred structure and the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله involvement with it.
